task.name: grasp_spatula_place_basket
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the wooden spatula and place it in the blue basket.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the wooden spatula.
2. Grasp the wooden spatula with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the blue basket.
4. Release the gripper to place the wooden spatula into the blue basket.
